title: Pregnant Woman Finds Dead Body in Backyard Shed
description:
Police responded to a home in Las Cruces, New Mexico after a woman found a 34-year-old man dead from a gunshot wound in the backyard shed. The suspect, Isaiah Joseph Rea, aka "Izzy," claimed he thought someone “wanted him to do it," and became the subject of a days-long manhunt. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
